_about: Which lift on the map is which lift in the resort's live feed (cervinia.it/en/impianti). Keys are the feed's names, values the OpenStreetMap way ids of that lift. 'covered' is the box of the lifts the feed reports on (Breuil-Cervinia and Valtournenche): a lift there that is missing from today's feed is not running today. Lifts outside the box and not named here - most of Zermatt - have no live state, and the router says so.
